source_text: A total of 722 adult female Anopheles mosquitoes were collected indoor at Mibellon out of which 584 (80.1%) were morphologically identified as An. funestus group... Out of the 120 An. funestus s.l. mosquitoes randomly selected and tested, An. funestus s.s. was found to be the only member of the group present at Mibellon.
